items.description:
This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

items.name: Boots of Landing
items.description:
These boots allow the wearer to recover instantly from a fall and can absorb some damage from falling once per day.
The wearer lands on her feet no matter how far she falls,
and takes 2 fewer dice of damage from the fall than normal.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, catfall; Cost 500 gp

items.name: Ring of the Chelish Agent
items.description: This elegant ring is crafted of dark silver and etched with the emblem of House Thrune, the ruling family of Cheliax. It is a mark of authority and protection among agents of the Chelish government. The ring is often awarded to those who have proven their loyalty and prowess in the service of the infernal nation. The wearer feels a subtle aura of safety and strength, as if shielded by an unseen force.

This amulet, usually containing some type of magically preserved monster hide or other natural armor—such as bone, horn, carapace, or beast scales—toughens the wearer’s body and flesh, giving him an enhancement bonus to his natural armor from +1 to +5, depending on the kind of amulet.

items.name: Maven's Precision
items.description: Maven's Precision is a darkwood heavy crossbow with intricate carvings of harpies swirling around its limbs, their wings extending towards the drawstring. This weapon once belonged to Maven, a renowned harpy sniper in the south Shackles, who was feared for her deadly precision and her ability to pick off foes distracted by her sisters' enchanting songs.

items.name: Horn
items.description: The horn is often regarded as the predecessor to both the trumpet and the cornet. While it is primarily made from brass, there are also variants crafted from bone, which are particularly favored in remote, cold, or mountainous regions. They can be used for music, drive for battles, or alarms.

items.description:
Collected Prayers of the Forge-Lord in WartimeTranscribed from the war sermons of Lord Commander Davran Forgearm, delivered before the Walls of Gallowspire, 3820 AR.
Physical Description:A modest, weathered book, bound in smoke-cured leather and banded with riveted iron corners. A hammer sigil embossed in faded gold adorns the front, with a clasp shaped like a clenched gauntlet. Inside, fine dwarven vellum is inked with dense Taldane script and occasional dwarven runes of emphasis and reverence.

Part of the Carriers by Calvin line of luxury containers, this finely crafted leather satchel has runework hidden in its stitching.
This dimensional pocket magically stores up to 100 cubic feet of items, and reduces their material-plane-weight by 75%.

items.description:
"One swig, one blessing, one tale to tell—or forget."

Caydenbrew Teenie-Kegs are single-serving wooden kegs of Cayden Cailean’s iconic brew, blessed in his name and crafted for adventurers, rogues, and pirates who seek fortune, bravery, and maybe just a bit of luck. Compact and practical, they’re a common sight among the devout—or those who just like to party.

items.name: Moonmoth Embrace
items.description:
This elegant black leather armor is inlaid with bronze filigree that forms curling patterns across the chest and shoulders, culminating in a striking symbol of a moth—wings outstretched, eyes on the tips of its wings, staring into the unknown. A sacred emblem of Desna, the Song of the Spheres, this moth represents freedom, journeys, and dreams. Mithral lining & chain shirt woven into it.
Moonmoth’s Embrace functions as +1 studded leather armor, but also bears a subtle blessing of Desna’s favor.

Once the regalia of King Dorn Helbraaz, ruler of the dwarven settlement of Gol-Khazak, the crown was meant to symbolize resilience and unity in the face of the pirate lords of the Shackles.
Corrupted by its history, the crown enables the wearer to cast 'Command Undead' once per day at the wearer's level.

items.description:

items.description:
A famous recipe from Savage Sustenance, these spicy and flavorful tacos will surprise & delight any diners!
Enjoyer of these tacos is granted the Caimon Taco Buff, which grants +20 movement on a charge attack, a 20 swim speed and the ability to charge through water, and the ability to hold one's breath for 30 minutes.
